home.hero_secondary: Proximity, availability, responsiveness and attentive listening are central to each case in order to deliver bespoke, effective solutions.

aboutus.title: A career rooted in Business Law
aboutus.intro: SAINT-HILAIRE Law Firm serves companies, directors and individuals through expertise structured around Business Law, Compliance and Litigation.
aboutus.profile_title: A lawyer at the crossroads of Advisory and Litigation
aboutus.profile_body: Holding a Master’s degree (Master 2) in Business Law, Maître SAINT-HILAIRE has developed a cross-functional approach to Business Law, assisting clients in both Advisory and Litigation work. His experience in Banking Compliance gives him a detailed understanding of regulatory and risk issues.
aboutus.approach_body: Driven by constant curiosity, Maître SAINT-HILAIRE strives to grasp the economic and strategic stakes of each case. His dynamism and focus on efficiency guide the search for concrete, tailored solutions.
aboutus.timeline_aria: Key stages in Maître SAINT-HILAIRE's career
aboutus.timeline_1_body: Advanced training in Corporate Law, Contract Law, Business Litigation and Corporate Governance.
aboutus.timeline_2_body: Experience in Banking Compliance with a practice oriented towards risk prevention and regulatory implementation.
aboutus.timeline_3_body: Legal career started abroad in 2015, followed by admission to the Essonne Bar, with a practice centred on Business Law, Immigration Law and Civil Litigation.
